name: Pond0x PNDX public directTransfer
summary: The Pond0x (PNDX) token kept solady's mock helpers directTransfer(from, to, amount) and directSpendAllowance as public functions without access control, so anyone could move anyone's PNDX. Hours after launch, takers moved PNDX out of holders and pools with directTransfer and sold it into the Uniswap PNDX/WETH pools.

campaign.selection: Successful direct calls to PNDX 0x1d4214081985ad20aa3ca93a2206ae792635cbec with selector 0xf83d1791 (directTransfer) whose from argument differs from the transaction sender, from the token's complete Etherscan txlist; the anchor excluded.

notes: Stolen PNDX has no market that could absorb it (the pools held at most about 18.6 WETH), so per rule 15 the loss is what takers realised: the net WETH that left the four PNDX/WETH Uniswap pools in transactions sent by the 1,431 bundle senders, valued at the anchor-time WETH price.

This is a lower bound: it nets the takers' own buys and misses thefts routed through contracts, which the bundle also omits; legitimate own-balance directTransfer calls are excluded by the selection rule.
